projection.instruction: Return `verbatim_request` as a single string containing the original user prompt verbatim, without changing its wording.

final_schema.description: Response object containing the current state input under the semantic keyword verbatim_request. Earlier accepted inputs remain in the iterator's separate indexed records.

verbatim_request.description: The `verbatim_request` property is a string containing the original user prompt verbatim, without changing any of its wording.
